purpose: Document first-party discovery, current public map access outcomes, and bounded anonymous parcel-geometry review for Bida.
assessment: The official Niger State Ministry of Lands and Survey and NIGIS agency establish the relevant state land-administration route. The NIGIS public Maps page exposes only static regional/LGA/cadastral-zone images, with the cadastral image explicitly Minna-focused. No anonymous Bida parcel feature response, safe native parcel ID, CRS, or full polygon was obtained. No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or unsafe field request was used.
registryAssessment: registryFound remains null: a state custodian is evidenced, but no public Bida cadastral map/API or parcel geometry was verified. General agency and legal-service prose is not treated as source integration.
